title: SupportDNA Golden Evaluation Set Schema
description: Validation schema for the held-out golden evaluation set of the SupportDNA AI customer support agent.

golden_id.description: Unique identifier for golden evaluation case.

source_id.description: Originating thread root or turn ID from the held-out raw corpus.

customer_message.description: Exact, unedited raw customer message text.

ground_truth_intent.description: One of the 11 verified business intents from the AppleSupport taxonomy.

ground_truth_customer_goal.description: Concise summary of the customer's desired outcome or resolution objective.

ground_truth_issues.description: List of distinct technical issues, symptoms, or concerns raised.

ground_truth_action.description: Operational action the agent should execute.

escalation_required.description: Whether the case requires human agent escalation.

evidence_expectation.description: Expected historical retrieval evidence profile for this inquiry.

expected_reply_requirements.description: Criteria the generated reply must satisfy for factual grounding, tone, and actionability.

edge_case_category.description: Applicable query difficulty and edge case categorizations.

human_reasoning.description: Annotation justification explaining the intent, action, and evidence expectations.
